partial_structures_positive_geometry.name: partial_structures_positive_geometry
partial_structures_positive_geometry.value:
("partial_structures"."length_m" is null or "partial_structures"."length_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."width_m" is null or "partial_structures"."width_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."area_sq_m" is null or "partial_structures"."area_sq_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."clear_height_m" is null or "partial_structures"."clear_height_m" > 0)

components_year_ranges.name: components_year_ranges
components_year_ranges.value:
("components"."construction_year" is null or "components"."construction_year" between 1700 and 2200)
        and ("components"."install_year" is null or "components"."install_year" between 1700 and 2200)

document_extraction_invocations_stage_sh.name: document_extraction_invocations_stage_shape
document_extraction_invocations_stage_sh.value:
("document_extraction_invocations"."stage" = 'PAGE_CLASSIFICATION' and "document_extraction_invocations"."category" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_invocations"."stage" = 'SECTION_EXTRACTION'
          and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."category"), '') is not null)

document_extraction_invocations_identity.name: document_extraction_invocations_identity_not_blank
document_extraction_invocations_identity.value:
nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."prompt_version"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."provider"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."model"), '') is not null

document_extraction_invocations_usage_no.name: document_extraction_invocations_usage_non_negative
document_extraction_invocations_usage_no.value:
("document_extraction_invocations"."duration_ms" is null or "document_extraction_invocations"."duration_ms" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_invocations"."input_tokens" is null or "document_extraction_invocations"."input_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_invocations"."output_tokens" is null or "document_extraction_invocations"."output_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_invocations"."estimated_cost" is null or "document_extraction_invocations"."estimated_cost" >= 0)

document_extraction_invocations_cost_pai.name: document_extraction_invocations_cost_pair
document_extraction_invocations_cost_pai.value:
("document_extraction_invocations"."estimated_cost" is null and "document_extraction_invocations"."cost_currency" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_invocations"."estimated_cost" is not null and "document_extraction_invocations"."cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

document_extraction_invocations_error_sh.name: document_extraction_invocations_error_shape
document_extraction_invocations_error_sh.value:
("document_extraction_invocations"."status" = 'FAILED'
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."error_code"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_invocations"."error_message"), '') is not null)
        or ("document_extraction_invocations"."status" <> 'FAILED'
          and "document_extraction_invocations"."error_code" is null and "document_extraction_invocations"."error_message" is null)

document_extraction_invocations_timing_s.name: document_extraction_invocations_timing_shape
document_extraction_invocations_timing_s.value:
("document_extraction_invocations"."status" = 'RUNNING' and "document_extraction_invocations"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_invocations"."status" in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') and "document_extraction_invocations"."completed_at" is not null)

document_extraction_runs_identity_not_bl.name: document_extraction_runs_identity_not_blank
document_extraction_runs_identity_not_bl.value:
nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."pipeline_version"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."provider"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."model"), '') is not null

document_extraction_runs_usage_non_negat.name: document_extraction_runs_usage_non_negative
document_extraction_runs_usage_non_negat.value:
("document_extraction_runs"."duration_ms" is null or "document_extraction_runs"."duration_ms" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_runs"."input_tokens" is null or "document_extraction_runs"."input_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_runs"."output_tokens" is null or "document_extraction_runs"."output_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("document_extraction_runs"."estimated_cost" is null or "document_extraction_runs"."estimated_cost" >= 0)

document_extraction_runs_cost_pair.name: document_extraction_runs_cost_pair
document_extraction_runs_cost_pair.value:
("document_extraction_runs"."estimated_cost" is null and "document_extraction_runs"."cost_currency" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_runs"."estimated_cost" is not null and "document_extraction_runs"."cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

document_extraction_runs_error_shape.name: document_extraction_runs_error_shape
document_extraction_runs_error_shape.value:
("document_extraction_runs"."status" = 'FAILED'
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."error_stage"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."error_code"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_extraction_runs"."error_message"), '') is not null)
        or ("document_extraction_runs"."status" <> 'FAILED'
          and "document_extraction_runs"."error_stage" is null
          and "document_extraction_runs"."error_code" is null
          and "document_extraction_runs"."error_message" is null)

document_extraction_runs_timing_shape.name: document_extraction_runs_timing_shape
document_extraction_runs_timing_shape.value:
("document_extraction_runs"."status" = 'PENDING'
          and "document_extraction_runs"."started_at" is null and "document_extraction_runs"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_runs"."status" in ('CLASSIFYING', 'EXTRACTING', 'VALIDATING', 'PERSISTING')
          and "document_extraction_runs"."started_at" is not null and "document_extraction_runs"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("document_extraction_runs"."status" in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
          and "document_extraction_runs"."started_at" is not null and "document_extraction_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

document_processing_runs_error_shape.name: document_processing_runs_error_shape
document_processing_runs_error_shape.value:
(
        "document_processing_runs"."status" = 'FAILED'
        and nullif(btrim("document_processing_runs"."error_code"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("document_processing_runs"."error_message"), '') is not null
      ) or (
        "document_processing_runs"."status" <> 'FAILED'
        and "document_processing_runs"."error_code" is null
        and "document_processing_runs"."error_message" is null
      )

document_processing_runs_timing_shape.name: document_processing_runs_timing_shape
document_processing_runs_timing_shape.value:
(
        "document_processing_runs"."status" = 'UPLOADED'
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_started_at" is null
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_completed_at" is null
        and "document_processing_runs"."page_count" is null
      ) or (
        "document_processing_runs"."status" = 'PARSING'
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_started_at" is not null
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_completed_at" is null
        and "document_processing_runs"."page_count" is null
      ) or (
        "document_processing_runs"."status" in ('PARSED', 'EXTRACTION_PENDING', 'EXTRACTED')
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_started_at" is not null
        and "document_processing_runs"."parsing_completed_at" is not null
        and "document_processing_runs"."page_count" is not null
      ) or "document_processing_runs"."status" = 'FAILED'

documents_partial_structure_requires_bri.name: documents_partial_structure_requires_bridge
documents_partial_structure_requires_bri.value: "documents"."partial_structure_id" is null or "documents"."bridge_id" is not null

documents_ingestion_metadata_complete.name: documents_ingestion_metadata_complete
documents_ingestion_metadata_complete.value:
(
        "documents"."checksum_sha256" is null and "documents"."mime_type" is null
        and "documents"."size_bytes" is null and "documents"."storage_key" is null
      ) or (
        "documents"."checksum_sha256" is not null and "documents"."mime_type" is not null
        and "documents"."size_bytes" is not null and "documents"."storage_key" is not null
      )

documents_ingested_pdf_valid.name: documents_ingested_pdf_valid
documents_ingested_pdf_valid.value:
"documents"."mime_type" is null or (
        "documents"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf'
        and "documents"."size_bytes" > 0
        and nullif(btrim("documents"."storage_key"), '') is not null
      )

findings_non_negative_measurements.name: findings_non_negative_measurements
findings_non_negative_measurements.value:
("findings"."dimension_length" is null or "findings"."dimension_length" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."dimension_width" is null or "findings"."dimension_width" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."dimension_depth" is null or "findings"."dimension_depth" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."quantity" is null or "findings"."quantity" >= 0)

findings_dimension_unit_pair.name: findings_dimension_unit_pair
findings_dimension_unit_pair.value:
(
        ("findings"."dimension_length" is null and "findings"."dimension_width" is null and "findings"."dimension_depth" is null and "findings"."dimension_unit" is null)
        or
        (("findings"."dimension_length" is not null or "findings"."dimension_width" is not null or "findings"."dimension_depth" is not null)
          and nullif(btrim("findings"."dimension_unit"), '') is not null)
      )

findings_quantity_unit_pair.name: findings_quantity_unit_pair
findings_quantity_unit_pair.value:
("findings"."quantity" is null and "findings"."quantity_unit" is null)
        or ("findings"."quantity" is not null and nullif(btrim("findings"."quantity_unit"), '') is not null)

findings_svd_ranges.name: findings_svd_ranges
findings_svd_ranges.value:
("findings"."stability_rating" is null or "findings"."stability_rating" between 0 and 4)
        and ("findings"."traffic_safety_rating" is null or "findings"."traffic_safety_rating" between 0 and 4)
        and ("findings"."durability_rating" is null or "findings"."durability_rating" between 0 and 4)

historical_works_date_order.name: historical_works_date_order
historical_works_date_order.value: "historical_works"."started_on" is null or "historical_works"."ended_on" is null or "historical_works"."ended_on" >= "historical_works"."started_on"

historical_works_quantity_unit_pair.name: historical_works_quantity_unit_pair
historical_works_quantity_unit_pair.value:
("historical_works"."quantity" is null and "historical_works"."unit" is null)
        or ("historical_works"."quantity" >= 0 and nullif(btrim("historical_works"."unit"), '') is not null)

historical_works_amount_currency_pair.name: historical_works_amount_currency_pair
historical_works_amount_currency_pair.value:
("historical_works"."contract_amount" is null and "historical_works"."final_amount" is null and "historical_works"."currency" is null)
        or (
          ("historical_works"."contract_amount" is not null or "historical_works"."final_amount" is not null)
          and ("historical_works"."contract_amount" is null or "historical_works"."contract_amount" >= 0)
          and ("historical_works"."final_amount" is null or "historical_works"."final_amount" >= 0)
          and "historical_works"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
        )

bridge_evidence_derivation_valid.name: bridge_evidence_derivation_valid

recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid.name: recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid
recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid.value:
("recommendation_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "recommendation_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("recommendation_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("recommendation_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

source_evidence_bounding_box_complete.name: source_evidence_bounding_box_complete
source_evidence_bounding_box_complete.value:
(
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" is null
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" is null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" is null
      ) or (
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is not null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" is not null
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" is not null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" is not null
        and "source_evidence"."page_number" is not null
      )

source_evidence_bounding_box_range.name: source_evidence_bounding_box_range
source_evidence_bounding_box_range.value:
"source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is null or (
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" between 0 and 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" between 0 and 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" > 0 and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" > 0 and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" + "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" + "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" <= 1
      )

traffic_observation_evidence_derivation_.name: traffic_observation_evidence_derivation_valid

recommendations_quantity_unit_pair.name: recommendations_quantity_unit_pair

        or ("recommendations"."quantity" >= 0 and nullif(btrim("recommendations"."unit"), '') is not null)

recommendations_estimated_cost_pair.name: recommendations_estimated_cost_pair
recommendations_estimated_cost_pair.value:
("recommendations"."source_estimated_cost" is null and "recommendations"."source_estimated_cost_currency" is null)
        or ("recommendations"."source_estimated_cost" >= 0 and "recommendations"."source_estimated_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

recommendations_year_ranges.name: recommendations_year_ranges

        and ("recommendations"."planned_year" is null or "recommendations"."planned_year" between 1700 and 2200)
